# Sherrill among nation’s most popular governors as Trump sinks in New Jersey, poll says

Morning Consult poll gives Booker and Kim strong ratings; president is 21 points underwater in Garden State

By David Wildstein, August 18 2026 6:03 pm [...] Gov. Mikie Sherrill is among the nation’s most popular governors, while President Donald Trump remains deeply unpopular in New Jersey and both of the state’s Democratic U.S. senators hold solid approval ratings, according to a new Morning Consult poll.

Sherrill has a 55%-30% approval rating, giving her a net approval of +25 during her first quarter in Morning Consult’s gubernatorial tracking.
